name: Stari Ras and Sopoćani
description: Near Novi Pazar in southwestern Serbia, Stari Ras was a medieval fortress town and one of the first capitals of the Serbian state. It sits at a trading crossroads, with hilltop fortifications and old churches nearby. A short way off, Sopoćani Monastery is the highlight, a quiet religious complex that reflects contact between Western Europe and the Byzantine world.
